note: Katalog skenario = ground truth untuk evaluasi dan sekaligus artefak 'historical test cases' bagi korpus pengetahuan RAQA. Setiap test memakai ID yang sama di judulnya.

scenarios.goal: A visitor opens the portal home page.
A visitor opens every static page linked from the main menu.
acceptance_criteria: Non-empty title that does not indicate an error

scenarios.goal: The main menu exposes every expected item with its expected destination.
acceptance_criteria: Each menu item in site-map.js exists with the specified href

scenarios.goal: A visitor reaches a page by opening a dropdown menu and clicking an item.
acceptance_criteria: URL ends with the item's path

scenarios.goal: The 'Daftar PSB' call-to-action leads to the admission site.
The 'Info Terbaru' call-to-action opens the news list.
Statistic links (alumni, santri per jenjang) lead to valid targets.
acceptance_criteria: Anchors #tsanawiyyah and #muallimin exist on the santri page

scenarios.goal: Each featured-program card opens a modal with the matching title that can be closed.
A visitor opens the first latest-news item from the home page.
acceptance_criteria: Article H1 equals the card title

scenarios.goal: A visitor expands an FAQ question.
A visitor browses the news list and moves to page 2.
acceptance_criteria: Page 1 shows at least one card
Page 2 shows cards not shown on page 1

scenarios.goal: The total number of news items is consistent across the site.
acceptance_criteria: (lastPage-1)*perPage + itemsOnLastPage equals the sum of category counts in the sidebar

scenarios.goal: A category page lists exactly the items the sidebar count promises, under both URL formats.
A monthly archive shows only items from that month.
acceptance_criteria: All card dates fall within the archive month

scenarios.goal: Opening an article from the list shows consistent data.
Breadcrumb and share links refer to the current article.
acceptance_criteria: WhatsApp/Facebook/Twitter links contain the article URL

scenarios.goal: Related articles exclude the article being read.
acceptance_criteria: Current URL not in related list

scenarios.goal: The view counter behaves monotonically.
acceptance_criteria: Count after reload >= count before (value itself is volatile)

scenarios.goal: A visitor opens a student article from the list.
acceptance_criteria: Article H1 equals the card title

scenarios.goal: 'Salin Link' copies the article URL.
acceptance_criteria: Clipboard content equals the article URL

scenarios.goal: The SIMASIS login form is complete and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Username and password inputs are reachable by accessible name/placeholder

scenarios.goal: Submitting an empty login form is rejected.
Invalid credentials are rejected with a clear message.
A valid test account can sign in.
'Kembali ke Landing Page' returns to the portal.
Internal links on key pages are not broken.
Links to the school's own domains use HTTPS.
Images on key pages load.
acceptance_criteria: Every image URL returns < 400 with an image/* content type

scenarios.goal: Key pages have no critical accessibility violations.
acceptance_criteria: axe-core reports no 'critical' violation for WCAG 2.x A/AA

scenarios.goal: Each key page declares itself as canonical.
Key pages fit a phone screen.
acceptance_criteria: No horizontal overflow on Pixel 7 viewport
